content: Sharing options: DLL drop into Assets/Plugins; embedded UPM package under Packages/ (mutable, auto-detected, no manifest entry needed, must be in VCS); manifest file: path; MSBuildForUnity; CsprojToAsmdef. Simplest single-source-of-truth: keep source in Packages/com.perihelion.sim with asmdef and glob it from a .NET csproj.
